_note: Standalone rule definition for the destination_fqdn enrichment. The rule itself is POSTed to Graylog as a regular pipeline rule, but it lives inside the user's existing 'Enrichment' pipeline (id 697f0960eeb15b769f4470a3) at stage 2, alongside the existing 'ipam enrich client_ip' and 'ipam enrich sender_ip to sender_fqdn' rules. Re-applying via pipelines/apply.py would NOT work here — apply.py creates or replaces a whole pipeline, but this rule needs to be spliced into a user-managed pipeline. To redeploy, run pipelines/extend_enrichment_destination.py (or POST the rule + PUT the pipeline source manually).

rules.title: ipam enrich destination_ip to destination_fqdn
rules.description: Mirror of 'ipam enrich client_ip' but for destination_ip. Resolves internal destinations to their PTR-recorded FQDN via the infoblox-nios-ptr lookup table. External IPs return 'unknown' (Infoblox lookup default). Lets dashboards show destination_fqdn alongside raw IPs for internal LAN traffic.
